title: HB 6 (87R): Relating to election integrity and security, including by preventing fraud in the conduct of elections in this state; increasing criminal penalties; creating criminal offenses.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) SECTION 3.09 (amends Election Code 86.006(a-1))
(quote) (a-1) The voter may deliver a marked ballot in person to the early voting clerk's office only while the polls are open on election day. A voter who delivers a marked ballot in person must present an acceptable form of identification described by Section 63.0101.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(other) Sec 1.01-1.06: short title Election Integrity Protection Act of 2021, purpose, findings, legislative intent, strict construction, definition of public official.
(other) Sec 2.01-2.02: death-certificate abstracts to voter registrars; register of spoiled ballots.
(other) Sec 3.01-3.11: poll watchers and who may be in polling place, ballot board room, counting station.
(other) Sec 4.01-4.05: assistance to voters; mail ballot assistant disclosures and offenses.
(other) Sec 5.01-5.04: provisional voting offenses, illegal voting, influencing a vote, paid vote harvesting.
(other) Sec 6.01-6.04: courts: panels, priority and assignment of election proceedings.
(other) Sec 7.01-7.04: repeal of 86.0052(b) and 86.0105(b); severability; effective September 1, 2021.
